name: PRIME GIRL
source:
Ayakane city, Kanto region, Japan. It is the Christmas Eve.

The main character--Takuya Minagawa--an office worker in a small company called "ASH".

A call from his best friend, Tadasuke Enomoto. from the cocktail bar "Maya".

What will be waiting in Maya?

A new encounter, and irreplaceable friends...
translation:
日本关东地区绫奏市，平安夜。

主人公皆川拓也，是小公司“ASH”的职员。

好友榎本忠助从鸡尾酒酒吧“Maya”打来电话。

Maya里等待着什么？

新的邂逅，以及无法替代的朋友……
